name: Foundry: Press and Crack
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: PRESS AND CRACK — THE FOUNDRY circuit's press+collapse pair (tier 3; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 13). A VERTICAL stamping press hammers the center island B while the RIGHT island C is a timed destructible cascade that erodes left-to-right and drops away entirely — so B is a permanent press-dodge deck and C is a shrinking collapse you get flushed off. Islands A and B (its edges) are permanent refuges, so the arena stays completable: the collapse of C reshapes the fight without stranding anyone. Two families (crusher + destructible collapse). Tier 3.

DOCTRINE FIT: (A) PRESS on B (center x2030): vertical anvil crusher, LETHAL head via kill(&ring_out); long open dwell (head parked ~y740 high) then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH for telegraph_lead 0.6s BEFORE a ~0.34s slam (period_s 2.8); narrow head_w 160 -> B's LEFT edge (x1580..1950) and RIGHT edge (x2110..2480) always clear; boost up above the parked head also clears a slam. (B) CASCADE on C (x3160..4060): three destructible slag blocks erode left-to-right (break_time 4.0/5.5/7.0) — each telegraphs growing CRACKS + a SHUDDER + a hazard flash for telegraph_s 1.0s BEFORE it vanishes; C is fully gone by ~7s and players are flushed to B/A. GI-1: islands A and B are PERMANENT (untouched by the collapse), so no crossing is ever stranded. FAIRNESS: no player spawns under the press or on C's first-to-go blocks; symmetric threat direction. CREDIT: a hazard/void kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked under the press or off collapsing C within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited.

GEOMETRY (void_is_floor): A x0..900 top1080 (permanent REFUGE) / B x1580..2480 top1080 (permanent, PRESS center x2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080 (destructible CASCADE), separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void, WIDENING as C's left blocks go): NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED at all times. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the press on B (shuffle to a clear edge on the beat / boost above the head); FLEE collapsing C on each block's 1.0s telegraph toward B/A. Neither reshaping removes a required landing (A and B are permanent). Verb: DODGE/FLY.
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the press times the fight on B, the cascade reshapes C — neither creates a bounce path across a gap.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the first Foundry stage pairing a live press with a SIDE-DECK collapse (foundry_crack_floor keeps all cores; this fully drops C). One-line read: 'dodge the pile-driver on the middle deck while the right island melts away — knock rivals under the press or off the crumbling edge.'
